Luke, I’ll commit to 12 tons this month if all five of us explicitly agree; otherwise, I’ll take 10 unless we settle on another allocation. My agreement is for this month, not a standing 12-ton quota.

Let’s also agree now that if next month starts at 80 tons, we each take no more than 6. That leaves 50, so either recovery outcome brings the lake back to 100. If we start at 100, we can reconsider our limits together. That gives us a concrete response to the downside rather than leaving it entirely to next month’s negotiation.

John, would you support 12 this month with that 6-ton fallback if the stock drops to 80?
